[Sir](../persons.html#712)
I am afraid you must tell me again of what poems you want to know the authorship. I am from home and I destroyed your letter, but all I remember seeing on the list you sent me were from the [Lyra Innocentium](../others.html#232), and were [Mr Keble](../persons.html#798)’s I return home on the 5th, but if you write sooner my address is Tyntesfield, Bristol[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY stayed at Tyntesfield, leaving on 19 August 1872 to go to Spring Hill: Guildhall Library MS 11,021, v 19 f 597, William Gibbs to Henry Gibbs (19 August 1872).
